risks: No page shows the fixtures-index-v4 dataset live, so a returned URL could be unverified.
Earlier issues said the index could not confirm the Hub datasets, and the agent's own proposals repeat this gap.
Most recent bee-scouts commits are health or served-skill entries, so the activity does not show much real building.
The fixtures label themselves as hand-derived with no checker run, so they are weak evidence of anything about agent memory.

wouldChangeMind: A live dataset page for fixtures-index-v4 under hivepunk-547-db38b7a4 showing the expected file list.
